user.title: Connect to HEMS
user.description: Enter your provider's HTTPS base address or complete endpoint. A base address automatically uses /battery. HEMS Client reads the selected measurements and publishes HEMS decisions; your automations control equipment.

measurements.title: Measurement sources
measurements.description:
Positive grid power means import; positive battery power means charging. PV must include direct battery charging. Select non-overlapping PV sources.

Note: HEMS does not check the age of the EV state of charge. Ensure the source integration keeps it current and marks it unavailable when it cannot be used.

error.invalid_endpoint: Use an HTTPS base address or endpoint without credentials, query parameters or fragment.
error.missing_solar: Select at least one PV production source.
error.incomplete_phase_current: Select all three phase-current sensors, or leave all of them empty.

abort.reauth_successful: API key updated. The next exchange will check authentication.

init.title: Measurement sources
init.description:

Note: HEMS does not check the age of the EV state of charge. Ensure the source integration keeps it current and marks it unavailable when it cannot be used.

telemetry_input_invalid.title: HEMS telemetry input needs attention
telemetry_input_invalid.description: The configured source for {input} is missing or no longer matches the HEMS contract. Select a compatible existing sensor in HEMS Client options.
